## What changed

Describe the user-visible outcome and the reason for the change.

## Verification

- [ ] `npm run check` passes locally.
- [ ] Relevant behavior was tested on every affected operating system, or the untested systems are listed below.
- [ ] Disk operations preserve dry-run and explicit-confirmation guarantees.
- [ ] New or changed downloads verify publisher-provided checksums.
- [ ] No credentials, tokens, private model URLs, disk identities, or generated installers are committed.
- [ ] Documentation and `CHANGELOG.md` are updated when users need to know about the change.
